metrics.name: coupon_apply_rate
metrics.pm_question: What share of users who see the coupon field actually apply a coupon?
metrics.formula: uniq(user_id where event='coupon_applied') / uniq(user_id where event='coupon_field_shown')

metrics.name: valid_vs_rejected_mix
metrics.pm_question: Of applied coupons, how many are accepted vs rejected, and what are the top rejection reasons?
metrics.formula: count(event='coupon_applied') vs count(event='coupon_rejected'); reject breakdown = count(event='coupon_rejected') GROUP BY reject_reason

metrics.name: coupon_conversion_lift
metrics.pm_question: Do users who apply a coupon convert to checkout at a higher rate than users who see the coupon field but don't apply?
metrics.formula: cohort_rate = uniq(user_id in coupon_applied AND reaching checkout_with_coupon with coupon_code NOT NULL) / uniq(user_id in coupon_applied); baseline_rate = uniq(user_id who saw coupon_field_shown, never applied, reaching checkout with coupon_code IS NULL) / uniq(user_id who saw coupon_field_shown, never applied); lift = cohort_rate / baseline_rate. Keyed by user_id.
metrics.confirmation_note: User confirmed the cohort/baseline definition and user_id keying this session.

metrics.name: coupon_margin_cost
metrics.pm_question: How much discount margin is each coupon code costing us?
metrics.formula: SUM(discount_amount) GROUP BY coupon_code (over events carrying discount_amount)

metrics.name: segment_cuts
metrics.pm_question: How do coupon apply rate, mix, and margin cost vary by device, geo, and destination?
metrics.formula: M1/M2/M4 sliced by device_type, geoip_country_code, destination
